title: Add regression gate comparison module
description: Create an isolated regression gate comparison module that converts accepted and candidate results into task-specific pass/fail decisions with structured reasons.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN task=code THEN candidate business_accuracy must not decrease and business_total must not shrink; WHEN task=type THEN candidate type_accuracy must not decrease, not_evaluable_count must not increase, and type_total must not shrink; WHEN metrics are equal or better THEN the gate passes; ref: docs/prd/regression-gated-prompt-optimization.md:67
review_initial_requirements: Review that gate logic is a deep module with a small interface and no OCR or filesystem side effects.
review_regression_requirements: Verify false accepts are prevented for code accuracy regression, code denominator shrinkage, type accuracy regression, type not-evaluable increase, and type denominator shrinkage.

title: Require target failures in optimizer proposals

acceptance_criteria: WHEN optimizer response omits target_failures THEN parsing fails; WHEN target_failures is empty or contains non-strings THEN parsing fails; WHEN target_failures is a non-empty list of strings THEN parsing succeeds and artifacts can record it; ref: docs/prd/regression-gated-prompt-optimization.md:74
review_initial_requirements: Review that target_failures is evidence for mutation intent, not a new semantic gate tied to unstable case IDs.
review_regression_requirements: Verify optimizer messages request row or failure-category evidence and existing prompt boundary instructions remain intact.

title: Wire regression gate into autorun accept flow
description: Connect optional regression evaluation into the shared optimizer loop after prompt, dev, and full gates and before commit.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN regression dataset is configured THEN accepted prompt regression baseline is evaluated at startup; WHEN candidate passes full but regresses the accepted regression baseline THEN candidate is discarded, prompt is restored, plateau increments, accepted_dir and best metrics do not update, and no commit happens; WHEN candidate passes regression THEN commit behavior remains task-aware; ref: docs/prd/regression-gated-prompt-optimization.md:62
review_initial_requirements: Review that regression gate is an accept gate, not a stop condition, and that it runs only after dev/full pass.
review_regression_requirements: Verify accepted regression baseline follows the current accepted prompt after an accepted candidate and is unchanged after discard.
